newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Telrad to buy $5 mln in Koor shares.
newsitem.headline: Telrad to buy $5 mln in Koor shares.

text.p: Koor Industries Ltd announced to the Tel Aviv bourse on Monday that its wholly owned subsidiary Telrad Holdings Ltd decided to purchase $5 million worth of Koor shares.

The purchases will be made both on and off the floor and will take into account the share price and state of the economy, the notice to the bourse said. The shares will be held for at least three months.
In September Telrad bought 8,840 shares or nearly 0.06 percent of the voting rights in Koor for about 2.4 million shekels.
Israeli companies are prohibited by law from buying their own shares but subsidiaries may buy shares in parent companies.
Koor currently trades at 300.49 shekels a share.
